none: PAS LANCUM-A84138: Roman coin: nummus of Magnentius
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [DNMAGNENTIVSPFAVG] ; R/ [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAE]

Late Roman nummus of Magnentius dating from c. AD350-353. Obv. description: Bare head left. Obv. inscription: [DNMAGNENTIVSPFAVG]. Rev. description: Two Victories holding a shield, lettering illegible ([VOT V MVLT X]). Rev. inscription: [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAE]
